Title: Runtime Container Default Notice
Author: Jane Doe <jane@example.com>
Posted: 2026-10-04
Revision: 1
News-Item-Format: 2.0
Display-If-Installed: games-util/runtime-launcher

Disabling the container runtime for games-util/runtime-launcher is no
longer supported. See https://example.com/docs/runtime (and the tracker
at https://example.com/issues/42).

Legacy flags can be inspected at https://example.com/legacy-guide.
